Introducing ClawdContext OS

ClawdContext OS
The AI-Native Operating System

Six layers of defense. Two planes of intelligence. One platform to secure autonomous AI agents from design to recovery.

“We're compressing 50 years of OS security evolution into a single agent platform. No dedicated hardware. No manual config. Just production-grade security — from boot to recovery.”

CORE ARCHITECTURE

The Two-Plane Model

Every operating system separates memory management from process execution. ClawdContext OS does the same for AI agents.

Memory Plane

CONTEXT = RAM

Manages what the agent knows. Like an OS manages physical memory — allocation, paging, eviction, defragmentation.

01

CER Monitoring

Context Efficiency Ratio — your agent's RAM utilization metric. Target > 0.6.

02

Smart Paging

Load skills on-demand. Never fill context with unused instructions.

03

Positional Placement

Defeat Lost-in-the-Middle. Critical instructions placed at start and end.

04

Eviction & TTL

Stale lessons expire. PID windup prevented. Context stays fresh.

05

Shannon SNR

Signal-to-noise ratio. More instructions ≠ more performance.

Runtime Plane

EXECUTION = OS

Controls what the agent does. Policy enforcement, sandboxing, audit trails, and human-in-the-loop gates.

01

AgentProxy

Reference monitor between LLM and every tool call. Per-skill capability grants.

02

Docker Sandbox

Isolated containers with seccomp profiles, non-root, restricted network.

03

Semantic Firewall

Second LLM validates intent before destructive actions execute.

04

FlightRecorder

Immutable audit log. Cryptographically chained. Behavioral baselines.

05

SnapshotEngine

Pre-action workspace snapshots. One-click rollback. Quarantine mode.

06

Human-in-the-Loop

Configurable gates for high-risk operations. Never fully autonomous on danger.

DEFENSE IN DEPTH
